description: The compact Vercel project lookup error row rendered a Retry button inside the expandable row button.
expected: The collapsed Vercel sync row should use valid interactive markup, with Retry available as a sibling control.
actual: React reported that a button cannot be a descendant of another button when the Vercel project lookup failed.
suggested_fix: Render the compact row expansion button and Retry action as sibling buttons inside a non-button row container.
